items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1978-12-03
items.q: And we're with Mr. Howard Jones, one of my favorite trombone players, and Mr. Dick Hammond.

ctx.x: We're at 455 Roxbury Road in Jackson, Mississippi. And we're with Mr. Howard Jones, one of my favorite trombone players, and Mr. Dick Hammond.
I work in the library there. I don't know if I told you, but we have a big collection there. Including Jack Teagarden talking about you on the stage.
